![](articles/figures/Logo_long_white.png)

The **GetCoolProteopipe** (GCP) package is the coolest R-package for
downstream analysis of MaxQuant proteomics outputs!

The package enables reproducible processing for non-programmers in the R
environment, including data transformation, normalisation, missing-value
imputation, batch effect correction, statistical inference and
publication-ready visualisation; all in a single unified pipeline!

With GCP you can perform elaboration of both global proteomics and
post-translational modifications (PTMs) analysis, and the way the latter
is computed is a key novelty of this package!

![](articles/figures/Logo_Small_white.png)

## ⚙️ Installation

Before installing, ensure the following are installed:

- R (version ≥ 4.3.1)
- Java (JDK), with the same architecture as R (64-bit or 32-bit).
- Git

Then open R (or RStudio) and run the following in the R console:

\`\`\`{r, eval=FALSE} if (!require(“devtools”, quietly = TRUE))
{install.packages(“devtools”)}

devtools::install_github(“FrigerioGianfranco/GetCoolProteopipe”,
dependencies = TRUE) \`\`\`

Follow the on-screen instructions to install all the dependencies.

## 📊 Workflow

A pleasant-to-read and complete vignettes to explain the full workflow
is there for you, why don’t you have a look at it:

<https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/articles/GetCoolProteopipe_workflow.html>

The next link is more boring, but if you want to look at the full
documentation of all the functions you can see it by clicking on this:

<https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/index.html>

Or maybe you can more quickly type on the R-console ‘?’ followed by the
name of the function you want to know everything about: you will see the
description of it and of all the needed arguments, along with useful
example codes!

Please, do not hesitate to contact Gianfranco (the cheminformatics nerd
expert) for any questions about the functions he wrote, or Clarissa (the
proteomics expert) for any questions about the proteomics workflow she
conceived.

![](articles/figures/20260430_GCP_workflow.png)

## 📖 Citation

If you use the package, please cite it as follows:

Frigerio G, Ansermino C, Andolfo A, Braccia C. GetCoolProteopipe
R-package (2026). GitHub repository.
<https://github.com/FrigerioGianfranco/GetCoolProteopipe>.

## ✍️ Credits

The idea that led to this work came from Clarissa Braccia’s mind. She
conceived the proteomics workflow and wrote initial R scripts; tested
the functions and suggested many improvements to them, revised all the
documentations and contributed to some examples, and supervised the
whole work.

The cheminformatics skills that allowed this package to exist belong to
Gianfranco Frigerio. He wrote all the codes of all the functions, as
well as the vignettes, documentation, and examples; implemented his
ideas on the development of the algorithms and the building of the
R-objects, and he is committed to maintain this package.

A fundamental contribution was made by Chiara Ansermino, who gave her
inputs and ideas for the development of functions, contributed to their
testing, and designed the logo of the package.

The work has been conducted within the Proteomics and Metabolomics group
(ProMeFa) led by Annapaola Andolfo, who gave important inputs,
supervised the development of the pipeline and revised the vignettes.
The group ProMeFa works at the IRCCS San Raffaele Scientific Institute,
Milan, Italy.

## 🏅 Acknowledgement

We acknowledge the entire ProMeFa group for their support. We also thank
Edoardo Niccolò Bellini for the initial idea on how to prepare group
names, which was integrated into the automatic_assignment option of the
GCP_AssignGroups function.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ExportGCPlist()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/ExportGCPlist.md)
  : Exporting the GCPlist
- [`GCP_ANOVA()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_ANOVA.md)
  : performing an ANOVA on data
- [`GCP_AssignGroups()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_AssignGroups.md)
  : Assign samples to groups.
- [`GCP_BarPlot()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_BarPlot.md)
  : Get bar plots with protein numbers.
- [`GCP_BoxPlots()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_BoxPlots.md)
  : Get Box plots from intensities.
- [`GCP_ChangeSampleNames()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_ChangeSampleNames.md)
  : Change the name of samples.
- [`GCP_ComBat()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_ComBat.md)
  : Adjust for batch effects
- [`GCP_Dendogram()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_Dendogram.md)
  : Get a dendogram of sample groups.
- [`GCP_DensityplotIntensities()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_DensityplotIntensities.md)
  : Plotting an overall density plot
- [`GCP_FilterNAperCondition()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_FilterNAperCondition.md)
  : Filter proteins based on missing values per condition
- [`GCP_FilterProteins()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_FilterProteins.md)
  : Filtering proteins
- [`GCP_FoldChange()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_FoldChange.md)
  : Performing a Fold Change analysis on data
- [`GCP_FoldChange_Multi()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_FoldChange_Multi.md)
  : Performing a Fold Change analysis on data, for more than 2 groups
- [`GCP_HeatMap()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_HeatMap.md)
  : Compute a Heat Map.
- [`GCP_LogTransformIntensities()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_LogTransformIntensities.md)
  : Log-transform intensities
- [`GCP_NAimputation()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_NAimputation.md)
  : Imputation of missing values
- [`GCP_PCA()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_PCA.md)
  : Get Principal Component analysis.
- [`GCP_ProteinsGrouped()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_ProteinsGrouped.md)
  : Know proteins shared by groups.
- [`GCP_ProteinsGroupedSummary()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_ProteinsGroupedSummary.md)
  : Get a summary out after the GCP_ProteinsGrouped function.
- [`GCP_QQplotIntensities()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_QQplotIntensities.md)
  : Plotting an overall Q-Q plot
- [`GCP_RemoveAllZero()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_RemoveAllZero.md)
  : Remove samples with all zero intensities
- [`GCP_RemoveSamples()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_RemoveSamples.md)
  : Remove samples from the dataset
- [`GCP_ReorderSamples()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_ReorderSamples.md)
  : Reorder samples
- [`GCP_ReplaceZerowithNA()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_ReplaceZerowithNA.md)
  : Replacing zero with NA
- [`GCP_ScaleIntensities()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_ScaleIntensities.md)
  : Scale intensities
- [`GCP_TestNormality()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_TestNormality.md)
  : Testing the normality
- [`GCP_Venn()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_Venn.md)
  : Get ggven for protein overlapping among groups.
- [`GCP_Volcano()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_Volcano.md)
  : Creating a Volcano plot
- [`GCP_plotPCA()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_plotPCA.md)
  : Plot Principal Component analysis.
- [`GCP_ratioPTMprotein()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_ratioPTMprotein.md)
  : ratio PTM on protein intensities
- [`GCP_ttest()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/GCP_ttest.md)
  : performing a t-test on data
- [`ImportOutputMaxQuant()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/ImportOutputMaxQuant.md)
  : Importing the output of MaxQuant
- [`ImportOutputProtDiscov()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/ImportOutputProtDiscov.md)
  : Importing the output of Proteome Discoverer
- [`ImportPTMs()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/ImportPTMs.md)
  : Importing PTMs
- [`checkGCPlist()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/checkGCPlist.md)
  : Checking if the GCPlist is suitable
- [`set_col_pal()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/set_col_pal.md)
  : Set the col_pal option.
- [`set_log_base()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/set_log_base.md)
  : Set the log_base option.
- [`set_name_column_groups()`](https://frigeriogianfranco.github.io/GetCoolProteopipe/reference/set_name_column_groups.md)
  : Set the name_column_groups option.
